parties: Mahindra & Mahindra Limited; Mahindra Last Mile Mobility Limited (MLMML); Lightrock; International Finance Corporation (IFC); India-Japan Fund (IJF)
headline: Mahindra Last Mile Mobility achieves Unicorn Status; valued at ₹10,822 crore after ₹322 crore Lightrock-led fundraise
sum: MLMML, Mahindra's electric three-wheeler subsidiary, becomes a unicorn after raising ₹322 crore from Lightrock, IFC and India-Japan Fund, achieving a post-money valuation of ₹10,822 crore and reinforcing market leadership with ~40% share in L5 segment.
implication: Growth-stage equity round by impact investors in a sustainability-focused last-mile EV business validates the commercial viability of electric commercial vehicles and corporate carve-out structuring as an independent capital-raising vehicle ahead of planned 2027 IPO.
detail: MLMML executed a binding agreement to raise ₹322 crore in equity, with Lightrock Cayman Holdings as the new lead investor and existing investors IFC and IJF exercising pre-emptive rights to maintain stakes. The transaction, completed on 30 July 2026, values the company at ₹10,822 crore (approximately USD 1.24 billion), making it a unicorn. Post-transaction, parent Mahindra & Mahindra's stake reduced from 78.11% to 75.79%, retaining operational control. MLMML achieved 100,000 EV sales in FY26 and 85% YoY volume growth in Q1 FY27, commanding 40% market share in the L5 electric three-wheeler category.
